QF.id: IV Introduction to Interest Rate Derivatives_22

question.text: The growth of financial derivatives globally accelerated primarily after which period?

explanation.text: The Logic: Financial derivatives came into the spotlight in the post-1970 period because of growing instability in the financial markets. The Trap: Commodity-linked derivatives had existed for almost three hundred years before financial derivatives came into prominence. By the 1990s, derivatives accounted for about two-thirds of total derivative-product transactions, but the acceleration began in the 1970s. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-IV workbook (Dec 2025), page 88.
